title: I Built a Ragdoll Sumo Wrestling Game
author: Pekardee
selftext:
[Ragdoll Sumo](https://playgama.com/game/ragdoll-sumo?clid=p_0e0a6eb9-4c21-4f00-9553-322126364010) \- Developed with a mix of Claude Opus 5, and Grok 4.6. The game is a one-touch physics fighting game where your goal is to ascend the Sumo ranks to the top and unlock skins from the shop. The first few iterations were just to nail down the ragdoll style physics. I had to experiment with different parameters (i.e strength, weight, speed) and a whole lot of fine tuning to get the game feeling challenging, strategic, yet beatable. 

I developed the audio and visual assets in a separate repo before merging with the physics engine. For audio - I went with opus 5 creating 3 loopable tracks with python code. Had to be specific about the purpose of each track, the expected tempo, and general outline (sumo, japan themed, oldschool, chiptune). I used Grok 4.6 to develop the "stinger" sounds (i.e. when you win or lose a match), and the cover artwork. Sidenote- in a separate game I am working on an update for ([Pocket Tyrant](https://playgama.com/game/pocket-tyrant?clid=p_0e0a6eb9-4c21-4f00-9553-322126364010)), I also used opus 5 for the music development but had it install some MIT sound plugin that made the tone quality much nicer. 

One of the harder aspects was figuring out the gold rewards, upgrade pricing, and shop pricing. I wanted the game to be fully playable and beatable without ads, but allow faster progression with ads so I implemented them similar to Bit Flight Simulator where you are prompted to watch an ad after upgrading a stat and can watch ads to double your run reward. I had opus run a full audit and analysis over progression speed and reward accumulation which helped me to fine tune the amounts. 

This is the second game I have published, and I built a review checklist and skill to assist with finalizing which has been a GAME CHANGER. Currently the review skill has 41 steps that include testing game loading, data save, ad reward verification, SDK verification, mobile viewing, among other things.  

I'd love to know peoples thoughts on the game and suggestions, if any.
